Camila / team —

I reviewed the SOW redline. Most items are resolved; outstanding legal items we still need final confirmation on: 
- Data retention clause (Section 5): Stellar requests retention of logs for 45 days. Our standard is 30 days unless customer signs an addendum. We can accept 45 days with an SOC2 addendum and a minimal cost uplift; need Naomi to confirm pricing/approval.
- Indemnity cap: we've agreed to the clause but we should confirm whether Stellar wants to mirror our standard $1M cap or increase for enterprise.
- Audit rights: acceptable with standard notice period; acceptable to include a SOC2 addendum in the contract rather than full audit rights.

I've attached the legal redline (SOW_redline_JB_20270811.docx). Once Naomi confirms the retention increment and the revenue uplift if any, I can finalize and countersign.
